subject: LlamaIndex edge plugin: certification for Redwood Edge runtime
messages:
From: LlamaIndex Integrations <integrations@llamaindex.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: certification for LlamaIndex plugin on Redwood Edge runtime

Hi Vanessa,

We're excited to propose a certified plugin for LlamaIndex that targets the Redwood Edge runtime (lightweight, low-latency deployments). Attached is a short spec (edge-plugin-specs.pdf) outlining the plugin's surface area, expected memory/CPU footprint, and tracing hooks (OpenTelemetry-compatible).

High-level asks:
- Confirm Redwood's compatibility checklist for Edge plugins
- Evaluate tracing integration (we expose OTLP and a passthrough for Redwood tracing)
- Schedule a 60-minute technical review next week to validate performance and security constraints

Repo: https://github.com/llamaindex/rdw-edge-plugin (branch: redwood-cert)

We've also attached sample traces and a small performance run (50 concurrent users). Let us know which format you prefer for the formal compatibility report.

Thanks,
Aditi Rao
Integrations Lead, LlamaIndex
integrations@llamaindex.ai
Attachments: edge-plugin-specs.pdf, sample-traces.json

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-23T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: certification for LlamaIndex plugin on Redwood Edge runtime

Hi Aditi —

Thanks for the spec and repo link. We can run an initial compatibility pass and validate tracing hooks. To help us scope the effort, can you also share:
- a minimal Docker image or runtime bundle (size & entrypoint)
- any native deps (libs) and whether they require root access
- a small eval script we can run in our infra to reproduce the perf numbers

We're available Tue/Wed 11/24-11/25 after 9am PT or Thu 11/26 in the afternoon. Proposed owners:
- Technical lead: Karthik Iyer (Platform Integrations)
- Partner GTM: Marissa Cole (ISV Partnerships)

I've attached a quick compatibility checklist template (compat-checklist.xlsx) — fill what you can, and we'll use it to triage.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
Attachments: compat-checklist.xlsx
